text:
alex: seeing failures in Next middleware after upgrading SDK — `ReferenceError: require is not defined` at request time.
jay: middleware runs as ESM on edge; you probably pulled the CJS entry. use `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference/edge'`.
alex: switched to `/edge` but now `TypeError: globalThis.crypto?.subtle is undefined` in Vercel preview and locally.
maya: some edge runtimes (and `next dev`) differ in WebCrypto surface. dev shim is ok for local, but prod needs a pure web-crypto build.
jay: SDK TODOs: 1) tighten package `exports` so `/edge` is unambiguous, 2) add init-time assert in edge build: `if (!globalThis.crypto?.subtle) throw new Error('Edge build requires WebCrypto — did you import the node build?')`, 3) docs + example for Next middleware.
alex: local workaround that worked: created `lib/rw-edge.ts` in app with `export { createClient } from '@redwood/inference/edge'` and imported that from middleware — preview started working.
maya: also watch for `AbortController` and streaming API differences. we should add `safeGetReader` and `ensureAbortController` helpers in SDK.
deploy-bot: branch `edge-next-compat` created; CI queued.
alex: thanks — saved a lot of time, will revert my adapter once the patch lands. :tada:
